In this workshop we're looking at:

- Visualising amounts (barcharts)
- Visualising distributions (histograms, densities, boxplots and more)

Start by downloading lab02.qmd into your 161307 project folder

[https://www.massey.ac.nz/~jcmarsha/161307/labs/lab02.qmd](https://www.massey.ac.nz/~jcmarsha/161307/labs/lab02.qmd)

Open your 161307 project in RStudio and then load up `lab02.qmd` and work through the workshop.

**Remember to take lots of notes and to ask questions of the teaching staff if there's anything you find unclear.**
